metadata.name: UserRegistrationRequest
metadata.description: This API is Used to Register a New User for Self Service Login.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: NewSSUserID
request_fields.description: Self Service New User ID to be provided for the Account Holder Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: Dani123 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Card holder's Address Line  1 Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Condition:Address Line 1 of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as one of the Self Service Registration Parameter in System and is Set as 'Mandatory' in System Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Card holder's Address Line  2 Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Condition:Address Line 2 of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as one of the Self Service Registration Parameter in System and is Set as 'Mandatory' in System Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: Country name of the Card holder's address For Input Values Refer Appendix Section 5.1 for Country Name Codes Valid Values: a-z Format:XXX Example:US Condition:Country Name of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as one of the Self Service Registration Parameter in System and is Set as 'Mandatory' in System Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: Primary Applicant's City Example: Los Angeles Condition:City Name of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as one of the Self Service Registration Parameter in System and is Set as 'Mandatory' in System Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Postal code of the card holder's address. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:46206 Condition:Address Postal Code of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as one of the Self Service Registration Parameter in System and is Set as 'Mandatory' in System Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: State of the card holder address. For Input Values Refer Appendix Section 5.6 for State Name Codes. Valid Values: a-z Format:XXX Example:MO Condition:State Name of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as one of the Self Service Registration Parameter in System and is Set as 'Mandatory' in System Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: EmailID
request_fields.description: Card holder's Email ID Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Condition:the Email Address of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as one of the Self Service Registration Parameter in System and is Set as 'Mandatory' in System Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: NewPassword
request_fields.description: Password to be Provided for the Account Holder for SelfService Login As per Password Policy Set in System Allowable Values: 32

request_fields.name: ConfirmPassword
request_fields.description: Verification of the new requested password by the user, Must be exactly same as the New Password Allowable Values: 32

request_fields.name: SSNLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Card holder's last four digit of SSN Valid Values:1120 Format:XXXX Example:1120 Condition:Last 4 digits of the SSN of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as one of the Self Service Registration Parameter in System and is Set as 'Mandatory' in System Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Date of Birth Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/dd/yyyy Example: 02/01/2020 Condition:Date of Birth of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as one of the Self Service Registration Parameter in System and is Set as 'Mandatory' in System

request_fields.name: CardVerificationValue
request_fields.description: CardVerificationValue number mentioned on the Card of the Account Holder Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX Example: 123 Condition:CardVerificationValue number mentioned on the Card of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as one of the Self Service Registration Parameter in System and is Set as 'Mandatory' in System Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: ListSecurityQuestionsAnswers
request_fields.description: List of Security Questions IDs and Descriptions as set in the System on the Product

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 1236547896325874 Condition: At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example: 12345 Condition: At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required when Decision Flag tag would be 1 -Account level Memo.

request_fields.name: SecurityQuestionID
request_fields.description: ID of the Security Questions set Need to Input exactly as what recived via GetUserRegistrationRequestParamters API

request_fields.name: SecurityAnswer
request_fields.description: Answer of Security Question set for password protection. Valid Values:a-z,0-9 Format:XXXX Example: John Allowable Values: 100

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
